reading_note: The arc: five foundational truths, when received, establish a base in the rational mind (Nous) for knowing the Divine. Through them the Father — who in His own Esse is unnameable, beyond every finite category — becomes accessible under the names by which He proceeds: as the Ambassador (the call that awakens), as the Father of Life, as the First Father (inmost good). From this Divine flows the Law, the living order that distinguishes those in good from those in evil. The teaching then narrates how the matrix of spiritual life sent forth the Divine Truth (King of Aeons of Light) into conflict with falsity from evil, subdued the rebellious falsities, and fixed them in their boundary until the consummation. The result: the whole cosmos stands firm, all states forming one living Body — the Grand Man — wherein the discrete degrees stand each beyond the other in their proper order.
